events.title: Rini Coolen resigns as manager of Dutch club 트벤터 .
그레임 수네스 is sacked as manager of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, and Glenn Roeder was made caretaker manager with Alan Shearer his assistant manager.
South Korean club Bucheon FC moved to Jeju Island and changed their name to Jeju United FC .

Alan Shearer becomes 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's top goalscorer of all time, scoring his 201st goal for the club, against 포츠머스 at St. James' Park, beating Jackie Milburn 's 200 goal tally which had stood for 49 years.

Turkey are banned from staging their six home qualifying matches for Euro 2008 in Turkey due to incidents during their 2006 World Cup qualification match against Switzerland , which finished 4–2 on November 16, 2005.
미들즈브러 comfortably defeat reigning Premier League champions 첼시 3–0 at the Riverside Stadium , the first time 조제 모리뉴 's 첼시 have lost by more than a single goal.
리버풀 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the FA Cup for the first time since 1921. The draw was a 5th round matchup.

A Football League under-21 team, composed of players from the Football League's three divisions, beats a Lega Nazionale Professionisti under-21 team, composed of players from Serie B , 1–0 at the KC Stadium .

The FA announce that the 2006 FA Cup Final , set for 13 May, will be held at the Millennium Stadium, as the builders of the new Wembley Stadium are unable to guarantee that it will be ready for the match. They also announce that the national team's pre-World Cup friendlies originally scheduled for Wembley will instead be held at Old Trafford.
Gary Kelly makes his 500th appearance for 리즈 유나이티드 football Club, in a 2–1 win against 루턴 타운 F.C.

맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 위건 애슬레틱 4–0 at the Millennium Stadium to win the Carling Cup . Should they finish in the top five this season, there will be a UEFA Cup place for the league's sixth highest placed team.

The month ends with 첼시's lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the Premier League narrowed slightly to 12 points. 리버풀, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 아스널 once again complete the top five, while 볼턴 원더러스 occupy the now sought-after sixth place. 선덜랜드 continue to prop up the top flight, having gained just nine points so far this season. 포츠머스 and 버밍엄 시티 complete the bottom three, with 포츠머스 now eight points adrift of safety. The top six remain unchanged from the previous month, although 왓퍼드 have moved to third and 크리스털 팰리스 to fifth. 밀월 has changed places in the relegation zone with Brighton, whom they lead on goal difference, while Crewe prop up the table.
